application_fee.proof_required_fee: Transaction details/receipt must be sent along with the application form
application_fee.details: Applications received without proof of payment of the application fee will not be considered. The notification states that the fee once paid will not be refunded under any circumstances.

qualification.details: The notification lists the essential qualification and experience as per the Teachers Eligibility Qualifications in Medical Institutions Regulations, 2025. It does not reproduce the individual degree-wise conditions of those Regulations, so candidates should verify their eligibility against the Regulations themselves. | The remuneration table and the document checklist refer to MD/MS/DNB candidates and PhD candidates, and the application requires an MBBS degree certificate, MD/MS/DNB degree certificate, PhD degree certificate, registration certificates and experience certificates.

salary_details.details: The pay is a consolidated monthly amount, with a 3% increment as mentioned in the notification.

selection_process: ANIIMS has invited applications for a "Hybrid Interview". The date of the interview will be intimated later
and necessary details and changes will be communicated through the ANIIMS website.
Candidates appearing for the interview must possess all the documents mentioned in the notification in original at the time of the interview. All the posts are purely temporary
and a selected candidate has no right to claim regular appointment.
how_to_apply: ANIIMS has not notified an online application portal. The application must be submitted in the prescribed format and sent by email.

Download the prescribed application format from the official website of the Andaman & Nicobar Administration (https://andamannicobar.gov.in) or the college website (https://aniims.andamannicobar.gov.in).
Fill in the prescribed proforma, including post applied for, department, personal details, academic qualification, research publications, scientific society membership and experience details.
Pay the non-refundable application fee of Rs. 500/- and keep the transaction receipt.
Attach soft copies of all required documents and the fee payment receipt.
Email the completed application with all attachments to [email protected] on or before 05.10.2026.
Copy of Photo ID issued by GOI (Passport or Aadhaar Card No.) - as per the checklist in the prescribed proforma
Work/experience certificate / Super Specialty certificate (if any) - as per the checklist in the prescribed proforma
Copy of the transaction receipt for the application fee
Applications that are incomplete in any respect, or received without the requisite documents and proof of payment of the application fee, shall not be considered.

content_sections.heading: ANIIMS Senior Resident Vacancy 2026 - Department Wise Details
content_sections.text: All 56 posts are for Senior Residents/Demonstrator on a contract basis for 01 year, extendable by another 02 years based on annual performance review. The Director, ANIIMS reserves the right to increase, decrease or cancel the notified vacancies at any stage of the interview/selection procedure.

content_sections.heading: ANIIMS Senior Resident Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: The notification lists the essential qualification and experience as per the Teachers Eligibility Qualifications in Medical Institutions Regulations, 2025. It does not reproduce the individual degree-wise conditions of those Regulations, so candidates should verify their eligibility against the Regulations themselves. The remuneration table and the document checklist refer to MD/MS/DNB candidates and PhD candidates, and the application requires an MBBS degree certificate, MD/MS/DNB degree certificate, PhD degree certificate, registration certificates and experience certificates.

faq.question: Q1. What is ANIIMS Senior Resident Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment drive by the Andaman & Nicobar Islands Institute of Medical Sciences (ANIIMS), Sri Vijaya Puram, inviting applications for Senior Resident/Demonstrator posts through a Hybrid Interview, on a contract of 01 year extendable by another 02 years based on annual performance review.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: A total of 56 vacancies across 19 departments, including 9 in Emergency Medicine, 8 in General Medicine and 7 in General Surgery.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: 05.10.2026 is the last date for submission of the completed application.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification?
faq.answer: Teachers Eligibility Qualifications in Medical Institutions Regulations, 2025, as stated in the notification. The notification does not list the degree-wise conditions separately.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: Rs. 500/- (Rupees Five Hundred Only), non-refundable. Proof of the transaction must be sent with the application form. The mode of payment is not specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply?
faq.answer: Send the completed application in the prescribed format, along with soft copies of all documents and the fee payment receipt, by email to [email protected] on or before 05.10.2026. An online application portal has not been notified.
